* Loan Amount and Term: The requested amount of $12,500.00 and the 3-year repayment duration directly influence the calculated monthly payment, which is then measured against your available income.

Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Bank. I would be happy to help you understand how a loan EMI works. 

An EMI, or Equated Monthly Installment, is the fixed amount you pay the bank every month until your loan is fully repaid. Each payment has two parts: the principal (the original money you borrowed) and the interest (the cost of borrowing). 

In the beginning, a larger part of your EMI goes toward paying off interest. As time goes on, more of your payment goes toward reducing the principal amount.
